html:
When is the best time to visit Son Tra Peninsula Da Nang? This is a question that many tourists are interested in, because this place not only has many famous attractions but also has many interesting games, especially fishing, diving and watching coral with sparkling and fascinating coral reefs. In particular, visitors can also see thousands of rare and precious species such as the red-shanked douc langur or the purple-shanked douc langur…

Coming to Son Tra Peninsula, visitors can also encounter many rare animals, including the Red-shanked Douc Langur, also known as the Brown-shanked Douc Langur, which can imitate visitors and is very close to humans.

Son Tra Peninsula is located about 10 km from the center of Da Nang city, surrounded by mountain ranges, located near the Hai Van pass, and has Thuan Puoc bridge…

Son Tra consists of 3 mountains rising high in the southeast, looking like a lion leaning out to the sea, so it is called Hon Nghe, the western mountain has the shape of a kite’s beak, and the northern one stretches towards Ngu Hai mountain on the other side of the sea gate, long like a horse’s neck, so it is called Co Ngu mountain…

In addition, when coming to Son Tra, visitors also encounter beautiful beaches such as: Bai Rang, Bai Da, Bai But… or resorts located right on the coast with beautiful views, besides there are also spiritual tourist attractions such as Linh Ung Son Tra Pagoda, an indispensable destination in the Da Nang tour itinerary.

Coming to Son Tra, visitors will also encounter clear blue beaches such as My Khe, Pham Van Dong beach, and experience at Furama resort, Sunny Beach, Olalani, or Silver Shore Hoang Dat…

Visiting Suoi Tien Son Tra, visitors will encounter a beautiful and pristine stone stream, in addition, there are ancient trees that are hundreds of years old or conquer the lighthouse, Ghenh Bang…

Beaches on Son Tra Peninsula

Nam O Beach

Coming here, visitors will immerse themselves in the cool water, or experience a cruise and visit the eco-tourism area, especially experiencing the unique culture of the Ka Tu Hoa Vang people.

Xuan Thieu Beach

Coming here, visitors will also encounter a quite pristine beach, clear blue water, white sand, with gentle waves, visitors can participate in games on the sea or on buoys floating on the sea surface, which will bring visitors a feeling of excitement.

Pham Van Dong Beach

The beach stretches along the East Sea Park, with white sand and clear blue water like jade. This is also the place where international card activities take place such as: Paragliding, jet skiing…

My Khe Beach

As a beautiful beach and also a place where sea festivals often take place in the summer, if you travel to Da Nang in the summer, My Khe Beach is one of the indispensable destinations when you have the opportunity to set foot in Da Nang.

So with the experiences of traveling to Son Tra Peninsula that Vietlook Travel has just shared above, hopefully this article will help you in some way for your trip to Da Nang.
